reason: I run plumbing and cleaning jobs all week and I already have a web person who handles the site. Another tool to set up and train, even if it is 15 minutes, is one more thing I will not get round to, and the free plan does not change that.
objection: I do not have time to set up and train another tool, and I do not trust a bot to book jobs in my calendar without me checking it.
would_change_my_mind: My web person sets it up for me, it is tested on my real price list, and it books straight into my calendar without me touching anything.
